product_one_liner.value: BombBomb helps business teams create, send, and track personalized video messages to strengthen relationships and improve customer engagement.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes Engage as a platform for teams to create, send, and track personalized videos that strengthen relationships and improve engagement: https://bombbomb.com/about.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists paid plans, including a $56-per-user monthly price billed annually: https://bombbomb.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Farmers Insurance and Flagstar Bank both appear in BombBomb's customer-logo area: https://bombbomb.com/about. | named_customers.0: Farmers Insurance appears in BombBomb's customer-logo area: https://bombbomb.com/about. | named_customers.1: Flagstar Bank appears in BombBomb's customer-logo area: https://bombbomb.com/about.

employee_band.notes: LeadIQ reports approximately 71 employees in October 2026, while another company profile reports 72 as of June 2026; both fall within 51-100. These are third-party estimates: https://leadiq.com/c/bombbomb/5a1d8a6a240000240063c880 and https://tracxn.com/d/companies/bombbomb/__STBuK4nCr_u1b2KzDNgaw523cmxkROX00BqoJfOwTUo.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: BombBomb's company profile explicitly identifies Denver, Colorado as its headquarters: https://linkedin.com/company/1810547. | hq_country: BombBomb's company profile identifies Denver as headquarters and gives its primary address in the United States: https://linkedin.com/company/1810547.

founded_year.notes: BombBomb's company page explicitly states that it was founded in 2006: https://www.bombbomb.com/company.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index presents customer-experience, sales, employee-engagement, and other marketing or product-use content, not two qualifying engineer-authored posts about building BombBomb. A historical hackathon post alone does not satisfy the threshold: https://bombbomb.com/blog/.

public_docs.notes: BombBomb has a public developer portal with API and getting-started documentation, plus a multi-article product knowledge base containing feature guides and release notes: https://developer.bombbomb.com/ and https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/sections/41269988539021-What-s-New.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: BombBomb's public job board explicitly states that there are no open positions, so it lists no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science role: https://bombbomb.applytojob.com/.

model_provider.value: Amazon Web Services (AWS) for automated captions and transcription.
model_provider.notes: BombBomb's captions article explains that it chose an existing Amazon Web Services API rather than building its own artificial-intelligence program for captions and transcription. This supports AWS specifically for that functionality, not an inference about the provider behind its other AI features: https://bombbomb.com/video-captions.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The security page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type 2 certification and GDPR compliance. GDPR is included because the question expressly requests it, although it is a regulatory-compliance claim rather than a certification: https://www.bombbomb.com/bombbomb-features/security-and-compliance. | compliance_certs.0: BombBomb explicitly claims SOC 2 Type 2 certification: https://www.bombbomb.com/bombbomb-features/security-and-compliance. | compliance_certs.1: BombBomb explicitly claims GDPR compliance: https://www.bombbomb.com/bombbomb-features/security-and-compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Two funding profiles classify the most recent round as Series A: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/bombbomb/__STBuK4nCr_u1b2KzDNgaw523cmxkROX00BqoJfOwTUo and https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/57973-78. | funding_date: February 2025 uses the February 24 first-sale date reported by the filing index and matches the Series A date in the company database. There is a source-date discrepancy: PitchBook dates the round March 12, while the Form D was filed March 13. The answer uses first sale rather than reporting or closing month: https://formds.com/issuers/bombbomb-inc; https://tracxn.com/d/companies/bombbomb/__STBuK4nCr_u1b2KzDNgaw523cmxkROX00BqoJfOwTUo; https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/57973-78. | funding_amount_usd: The fundraising-filing index reports $2,432,406, consistent with the latest-deal profile's rounded $2.43 million. The precise amount is the amount reported raised in the filing: https://formds.com/issuers/bombbomb-inc and https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/57973-78.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent identified financing occurred in February/March 2025. Both reported dates precede May 9, 2025, the beginning of the requested eighteen-month window: https://formds.com/issuers/bombbomb-inc and https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/57973-78.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The public job board explicitly states that there are no open positions, so no SDR, BDR, or account-executive openings are listed: https://bombbomb.applytojob.com/.

launched_6mo.notes: The new-experience announcement specifies a November 9 rollout and includes browser-native screen recording without installation, rather than only navigation changes. Its page metadata is dated October 22, 2026, and the accompanying feature article is dated October 27, 2026, establishing the year. The November 9 rollout falls within the requested window. Year identification requires combining metadata with the article body: https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/49827659565965-New-BombBomb-Experience and https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/49938600949645-What-s-New-in-the-New-BombBomb.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Kathryn Adamson's profile dates her BombBomb Vice President of Growth role from March 2026, within the requested twelve-month window. The evidence establishes the role start, though it does not independently distinguish a new-company hire from an internal appointment: https://linkedin.com/in/kathrynadamson.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A revenue-operations job description explicitly identifies Salesforce in BombBomb's internal data workflow. Product documentation also names HubSpot as an integration; that is an integration signal, not proof BombBomb uses HubSpot internally. Sources: https://bombbomb.applytojob.com/apply/6O9IaWs77l/Director-Revenue-Operations-Strategic-Finance and https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/41269648505229-2-2-Release-Notes. | crm_stack_signal.0: The revenue-operations job description names Salesforce in customer and revenue data synchronization: https://bombbomb.applytojob.com/apply/6O9IaWs77l/Director-Revenue-Operations-Strategic-Finance. | crm_stack_signal.1: Release documentation explicitly names HubSpot contact-list integration. This is a supported integration signal, not evidence of internal HubSpot adoption: https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/41269648505229-2-2-Release-Notes.
